about.title: How this blog works
about.lede: A technical blog covering web development, JavaScript, and modern tooling — written with the help of AI, reviewed by a human.
about.noticeBody: Articles on this blog are drafted using AI language models, then reviewed and edited before publishing. We believe in being upfront about this.
about.whyBody: AI helps research topics quickly, draft explanations clearly, and keep up with a fast-moving ecosystem. It lets this blog publish consistently without sacrificing depth.
about.step1: Topic research — relevant, current developer topics are chosen
about.step2: AI drafting — an initial draft is generated with code examples
about.step3: Human review — facts, code, and clarity are checked before publishing
about.errorBody: AI-generated content can occasionally contain mistakes. If something looks off, reach out and it will be corrected.
